description: Change of use of first floor from Class E (Commercial, business and service) to Class C4 (Small HMO) to provide 3 rooms, involving alterations to the fenestrations and refuse and cycle stores to the rear.
decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be similar to those of the original building and maintained and retained thereafter. This applies unless differences are shown on the drawings we have approved. Reason: To ensure that the development harmonises with the existing building and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, sound insulation measures shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, which demonstrate that the noise level of 35 dBLAeq,16 hour in living rooms and bedrooms during the daytime (0700 to 2300 hours) and 30 dBLAeq,8 hour and 45 dBLAFmax during the night time (2300 to 0700 hours) in bedrooms in accordance with BS8233:2014 and World Health Organisation, Guidelines of Community Noise shall not be exceeded. An assessment of the noise should also be carried out using BS4142:2014. Where the levels under BS8233:2014 and WHO cannot be met and/or the BS4142:2104 assessment shows an indication of adverse impact with windows open appropriate acoustic ventilation should be provided so that the room can be sufficiently ventilated. The acoustic performance of any passive vent, variable speed mechanical air supply unit or whole house ventilation must be sufficient to ensure that the noise level standards given above are not compromised.Reason: This condition is required to be pre-commencement to ensure the necessary sound insulation measures can be adequately designed into the development at an early stage and to ensure future occupiers enjoy a satisfactory quality of living accommodation in terms of noise and ventilation and to ensure the development does not adversely affect the operations of other noise generating uses in accordance with Policies D6 and D13 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 9 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a scheme detailing sound transmission and reduction measures to be installed between the existing ground floor use and the first floor residential accommodation. The scheme shall be designed to be 5dB better than that given in Approved Document E (2003 Edition incorporating 2004 and 2010 amendments) of the Building Regulations (Table 0.1a, page 12), shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for written approval. Once agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the approved details shall be installed prior to the development being occupied and retained in perpetuity thereafter.Reason: This condition is required to be pre-commencement to ensure the necessary sound insulation measures can be adequately designed into the development at an early stage and to ensure future occupiers enjoy a satisfactory quality of living accommodation in terms of noise and ventilation and to ensure the development does not adversely affect the operations of other noise generating uses in accordance with Policies D6 and D13 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 9 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to any above ground works, further details of the proposed solar PV array must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing, including: (i)	roof plans showing the position and orientation of the proposed solar PV array; (ii)	the number of solar PV panels and the total area of the proposed array; (iii)	product specifications including the power output of each panel; and (iv) confirmation of the electricity that the solar PV array will generate and the overall CO2 savings expected to be achieved. Reason: To ensure the development is designed to the highest energy efficiency and sustainable standards and to ensure compliance with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Statement prepared by Compliance 4 Buildings Ltd and dated 5th March 2024 and the approved details relating to the solar PV array. Prior to first occupation, 'as-built' Standard Assessment Procedure (SAP) outputs must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the development has achieved the targeted reduction in CO2 emissions. All of the approved measures must thereafter be retained for as long as the development is in existence. Reason: To ensure the development is designed to the highest energy efficiency and sustainable standards and to ensure compliance with Policy 31 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

Prior to first occupation of the development, a completed Water Efficiency Calculator for New Dwellings must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that internal potable water consumption for the proposed HMO will be limited to 110 litres per person per day (l/p/d) based on the Government's national calculation method for the purposes of Part G of the Building Regulations. Reason: To ensure the development is designed to the highest energy efficiency and sustainable standards and to ensure compliance with Policy 33 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The proposed cycle and refuse storage, as shown on approved drawing number 5160/LO/03 Proposed Plans and Elevations, shall be implemented prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved and retained permanently.Reason: To ensure future occupiers are provided with sustainable transport storage options and satisfactory refuse storage arrangements and to ensure compliance with Policy D6 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy 37 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Planning Fire Safety Strategy.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
